review:
A creepy Tim Burton-style fairground on 60 lines. Six or more spiders trigger Hold & Win, with multipliers and prizes inside.

A meter shows how many bonus symbols you've collected, and Chance x2 doubles your scatter and bonus odds for a slightly higher bet. Medium volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP. Plays like Royal Beellion, with a spooky circus theme that works all year.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
